purpose: Materialize the preregistered neutral plumbing for RATE_BETA without changing Core, scoring, bias, sizing, Forward Logger, runtime, payload, or publication semantics.

input_contract.week_end: Strict ISO YYYY-MM-DD. The plumbing does not resample daily observations and therefore does not invent a weekly sampling rule.
input_contract.pair: Explicit FX pair identifier; no implicit inversion is performed.
input_contract.fx_return: Pre-aligned weekly FX return produced by the certified replay/panel layer.
input_contract.delta_rel_2y: Pre-aligned weekly change in the pair-relative 2Y yield differential produced by the certified replay/panel layer.
input_contract.missing_values: FORBIDDEN inside an eligible OLS window

governance.b1_b2_rule: Do not infer, rename, threshold, or evaluate B1/B2 until their canonical preregistered definitions are explicitly materialized from source evidence.
governance.next_research_step: Backfill certified 2Y history later, build immutable PIT-aligned FX+2Y weekly panel, then run the unchanged 52W beta and preregistered B1/B2 OOS evaluation.
